card.name: Inside biologic and brand drug names
card.fires_on: Fires on the middle piece of a long drug name, such as the 'al' in efgartigimod alfa or the four-letter suffix after a biologic name. Also fires on the 'O' in NURTEC ODT.

modes.label: Salt or form ending
modes.description: The piece that continues a generic drug name into its salt or ester ending.

modes.label: Biologic four-letter suffix
modes.description: The hyphen and first letters of the random suffix added to a biologic's name.
